in_hebrew.name: Eustatius
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Eustatius הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek eu (good) and statos (standing, established), meaning 'well-born' or 'fertile'. In Christian tradition, St. Eustatius was a 3rd-century Roman soldier and martyr.
